name: zinput_bindmap_context_dispatch_from_keyboard_event
description: zInput_BindMapContext_DispatchFromKeyboardEvent maps a keyboard DIK code through the current bind-map context and invokes the mapped command callback when one is installed.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x470e80 loads g_zInput_BindMap_Current, calls GetCommandByAnyKeyboardKey, indexes m_commandCallbacks[commandId], returns when the callback is null, and otherwise tail-jumps to the callback.

Native smoke zinput_bindmap_context_smoke verifies keyboard dispatch through the active bind-map context invokes the installed command callback, and verifies an unmapped keyboard key leaves the callback count unchanged.
Binary Ninja still carries an unresolved-indirect-control-flow tag for the final tail jump, but the assembly is a typed zInputCommandCallbackFn tail call with commandId in ECX.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for @zInput_BindMapContext_DispatchFromKeyboardEvent@4 at 0x470e80 matches with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 12 relocation bytes and trimming 15 NOP bytes; Binary Ninja body is 33 bytes and the VC object symbol is 48 bytes.
